subject: [PATCH v2 6/8] NFSD: report listener creation failures through extack

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch improves error reporting for NFS listener creation failures by providing a more informative message to userland when the operation fails. The patch adds extack support to nfsd_nl_listener_set_doit() to report the transport name and error code, allowing userland to diagnose issues such as an unreachable local rpcbind. This change addresses a problem where the original error message was too generic and did not provide enough information for troubleshooting.
